name: Bots: basic brain
description: The minimal bot brain of phase 3 (step 3d): bots stroll in their starting village, walk to hunting grounds of their level (data/levelzones.xml, from stock spawns), kill monsters (warriors hit, mystics nuke), pick up their drops, rest, die and come back, learn skills for SP. Step 3e: follows the orders of the presence director (town errands and groups, hunting on the given ground, leaving out of sight or by the gatekeeper) and never takes a monster a real player fights or stands next to. Registers brain 'basic' with bots-core.

PvpFightBack.description: When a real player attacks a bot: base chance that it fights back like a player in PvP (flag, karma rules), else it flees and leaves. Adjusted by level difference and persona aggression.

Potions.description: Bots drink HP potions in a fight (they get 20 of their grade when they appear); the potion reuse is respected.

PotionHpPercent.description: HP percent below which a bot drinks a potion: min,max; each persona has its own threshold in this range.

FleeHpPercent.description: Below this HP percent with no potion at hand (and a fight it is losing) a bot runs out of the fight; still chased, it reads a scroll of escape.

KiteDistance.description: Archers and mages against melee monsters: close,to. When the monster is within its own reach + close, the bot steps back to 'to' (archers: at most bow range - 50) and shoots or casts again. 0 = no kiting.
